title: nfl.inbox_registry.v1 - config/inbox_registry.json
description: Inboxes NFL ingest scans. path is relative to the NFL repository (absolute paths are accepted but discouraged). NFL never creates a directory outside its own repository: a missing foreign inbox is reported 'unavailable'. Each inbox says who the items belong to: source 'local' (NFL's own operator inbox) or integration '<consumer>><provider>' (must be a registered integration in .constellation/SERVICE_MAP.md). Items without either are not committed (NFL_INGEST_UNATTRIBUTED).
